text:
sarah: RC built for private-installer v1.9.0-rc3. artifacts uploaded to https://internal.redwood/releases/private/v1.9.0-rc3 — need packaging window confirmation + cosign key rotation notes.
rohit: ack. kicked off cosign signing but HSM rotated yesterday, need to use backup key. pinging @security.
security-bot: Audit: key rotation detected. active key id=key-prod-2, fallback key=id=key-prod-1 (available for emergency signing).
lina: can we avoid re-signing existing components? we need deterministic checksums for airgap shrinkwrap.
michael: signing with backup key-prod-1 is fine, but we must record the cosign payload and fulcio attestation. attaching command to be deterministic.
michael: ```bash
COSIGN_PASSWORD=*** cosign sign --key cosign://key-prod-1 gcr.io/redwood/private-installer:v1.9.0-rc3
sha256sum private-installer.tar.gz > private-installer-v1.9.0-rc3.sha256
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy started on canary-cluster-a (3 nodes) at 1802568200.
rohit: small ask: pin base-image to ubuntu-22.04@sha256:abcd1234... in the installer manifest — we had base-image drift last release.
sarah: noted, @michael please confirm manifest pin before packaging.
michael: confirmed and pushed manifest commit https://git.internal/redwood/installer/commit/abc123 (pinned ubuntu-22.04@sha256:abcd1234).
lina: packaging will produce airgap bundle to s3://redwood-airgap/releases/1.9.0-rc3. ETA ~40m.
eva: change window? ops prefers 02:00-04:00 UTC, but APAC enterprise customers asked for earlier. propose 03:00 UTC target.
sarah: OK target 03:00 UTC. canary at 03:10, evaluation -> 03:30 full push if green.
rohit: rollback plan: auto-rollback to v1.8.5 if canary cpu > 80% or error_rate > 2% sustained over 5m. also revoke canary route.
ops-bot: rollout policy applied: canary_duration=20m, metrics=[p95_latency, error_rate, cpu_utilization], thresholds set.
michael: draft release notes: "Private Installer v1.9.0-rc3: fixes airgap checksum mismatches; base images pinned; cosign signed with key-prod-1 (see audit). Known issue: Windows SHA512 planned for GA."
rohit: pre-check for onprem: run `sha256sum -c private-installer-v1.9.0-rc3.sha256` inside the bootstrap container before install.
sarah: anyone object to the 03:00 window? @lina @eva
lina: build side ok.
eva: support ok, enterprise alerts queued.
security-bot: Audit note: cosign signature uploaded to sigstore at 1802568000, entry id=sig-789; recorded in release metadata.
sarah: packing airgap now, will post final artifacts + checksums when complete.
deploy-bot: canary finished: 3/3 nodes HEALTHY, all probes pass at 1802571000.
rohit: starting gradual push to dedicated pools: plan 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 35m, monitoring in prometheus dashboard.
michael: pushed release notes draft to internal docs: https://docs.redwood/internal/releases/1.9.0-rc3 (please review).
sarah: final artifact list:
 - private-installer-v1.9.0-rc3.tar.gz
 - private-installer-v1.9.0-rc3.tar.gz.sig (cosign)
 - private-installer-v1.9.0-rc3.sha256
 - installer-manifest.yaml (base images pinned)
sarah: uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-airgap/releases/1.9.0-rc3 and set acl to private.
lina: checksum verified on primary mirror and sampled on two mirrors.
eva: enterprise customer alerts dispatched at 03:05 UTC.
rohit: metrics look good — p95 stable, CPU under thresholds. proceeding to 50%.
ops-bot: rollout completed at 1802573490.
sarah: closing thread. flag for postmortem if we see regressions. thanks everyone :tada:
